_about: Methodology one-at-a-time sweep around the single reference slab (FM-17, FM-49). Each variable takes each of its planned values in config/model.json alone. There is no regional (roof) scenario: one generic slab of left atrial wall is modelled (FM-49). The HD Grid spacing stays at 4 mm (not swept); bipole orientation is swept on the fixed grid (FM-39). Deferred by the agreed drop order: Latin hypercube sampling, curvature, dense virtual array.
